t: An early low-cost RISC-V microcontroller for learning how small chips work.
steps: Find a Sipeed Longan Nano or Seeed Wio Lite RISC-V from a maker store or a used seller.
Install the free Visual Studio Code editor and add the PlatformIO extension.
Add the GD32V platform in PlatformIO and pick your board.
On Windows, install the DFU driver with the Zadig tool.
Hold the BOOT0 button and tap RESET to put the board in upload mode.
Upload the blink example and watch the RGB LED flash.
Try the Sipeed Longan LCD example to draw on the screen.
